content.text:
Two ways to write the greeting:

```rust tab="owned"
fn greet(name: String) -> String {
    format!("hello, {name}")
}
```

```rust tab="borrowed"
fn greet(name: &str) -> String {
    format!("hello, {name}")
}
```

And the two tables side by side:

```markdown tab="before"
| name | calls |
|---|---|
| greet | 12 |
| parse | 3 |
```

```markdown tab="after"
| name | calls | change |
|---|---|---|
| greet | 4 | -8 |
| parse | 3 | 0 |
```

The borrowed one copies less.
